proposals.evidence: CDIAL 14039 hastin explicitly gives Assamese, Bengali and Oriya hāti elephant, beside Nepali hāti. The eastern survey hati forms match these unaspirated regional descendants, with vowel length retained as transcribed and local Indo-Aryan transmission open. Exact response: hati.

The eastern survey hati forms match these unaspirated regional descendants, with vowel length retained as transcribed and local Indo-Aryan transmission open. Exact response: hati. proposals.evidence: CDIAL 959 aṣṭhīvat explicitly gives Assamese/Bengali ā̃ṭhu and Bengali hā̃ṭhu knee. Hajong atʰu and Bishnupriya athu select that regional knee family, with the survey dental t and absent nasalization retained as transcription/phonological qualifications. This follows the same eastern knee comparison used for the reviewed hatu forms and does not impose a retroflex or nasal spelling on the source. Exact response: athu.
